note: Selectors and guards the #94 stills check should enforce on the built #98 view (app side). Guard ids match check-comps.mjs; the comp-side twin proves each guard with a planted fixture (planted/). Fields marked (#105) are the ones #105 adds; the view must read them, not derive them.

targets.name: board
targets.assert: present; columns Rank/Team/Conference/Record/Δ/TR+ unchanged; only addition is the toggle cell

targets.name: board-row
targets.assert: one per ranked team in rank order

targets.name: row-toggle
targets.assert: button, aria-expanded true|false, aria-controls → panel id, accessible name (aria-labelledby team name until why.toggle.accessible_name is locked), ≥44×44, :focus-visible outline ≥2px

targets.name: cmp-above
targets.assert: data-gap == team.final_ranking_score − above.final_ranking_score; data-empty=true for rank 1

targets.name: cmp-below
targets.assert: data-gap == team − below; data-empty=true for the last ranked team

targets.name: part
targets.assert: one per parts[] entry, in parts[] order; data-weight == parts[].weight (#105, from DEFAULT_CONFIG); data-contribution == weight × (value_self − value_other); visible [data-part-label] == parts[].name

targets.name: chips
targets.assert: one per game; data-tag in quality_win|cupcake|bad_loss|none (#105 tag); data-venue in home|away|neutral (#105 venue); opponent_rank shown when ranked

targets.name: delta
targets.assert: == team.prev_rank − team.rank (#105 prev_rank); '—' when prev_rank is null

targets.name: few-games
targets.assert: present iff games_played < threshold (threshold: open question, comps use 4)

targets.name: share-btn
targets.assert: ≥44×44; produces the 1200×675 card for the same team+week URL

targets.name: sheet
targets.assert: 390 only: role=dialog, aria-modal, full width, close button ≥44×44

guards.rule: |Σ data-contribution − data-gap| ≤ 1e-9 per comparison; every shown number is the 1-dp rounding of its data
every [data-part] has a visible label (app: strict, no pending labels)
documentElement.scrollWidth ≤ 390 and no element outside a scroll container crosses the viewport
every button, a[href], [role=button], input, select, [tabindex≥0] is ≥44×44
row toggle reached by Tab matches :focus-visible and shows outline ≥2px (or box-shadow)
case-insensitive word match on text, alt/aria-label/title/placeholder/content/data-url/value and title: bet|bets|betting|bettor(s)|odds|market(s)|spread(s)|line(s)|pick(s)|lock of the week
unlocked slots render no text; locked/existing slots verbatim; no lorem/placeholder/TBD/{{ }}
computed colours ⊂ tokens.json (team data colours exempt via [data-team-color])
card and document exactly 1200×675; URL rendered; PNG 1200×675
no literal formula weights in renderer source; rendered data-weight ∈ parts[] for the state
each state carries its required selectors (#1 empty above, last empty below, ≥1 negative part, 4-part renders 4)
